# Kharch Log

> Kharch Log is an Android expense tracker by Easy Peeze Tools. It captures bank/UPI SMS, lets you confirm drafts, and stores expenses in your own Google Sheet. Lifetime unlock INR 149. Your data stays in your Google account - not on our servers as the source of truth.

Last updated: 2026-09-08
Canonical site: https://kharchlog.in/
Sitemap: https://kharchlog.in/sitemap.xml
Full corpus: https://kharchlog.in/llms-full.txt
Contact: easypeezetools@gmail.com

## Key facts

- Product: Kharch Log (Android)
- Publisher: Easy Peeze Tools (easypeeze.com)
- Price: INR 149 one-time lifetime
- Data: Google Sheets + Drive file scope; SMS on-device draft -> your sheet
- Support: easypeezetools@gmail.com
- Sister product: Pdf Buddy (Windows PDF editor) at https://easypeeze.com/

## Product

- [Home](https://kharchlog.in/): Android expense tracker that logs UPI/bank SMS into your Google Sheet. INR 149 lifetime.
- [All features](https://kharchlog.in/features/): SMS auto-capture, voice entry, Sheets sync, reports, and share invoice.
- [Blog index](https://kharchlog.in/blog/): Guides on SMS expense tracking, UPI habits, and Sheets vs budget apps.
- [FAQ](https://kharchlog.in/faq/): Common questions about permissions, Google Sign-In, Sheets, and lifetime access.
- [Glossary index](https://kharchlog.in/glossary/): Definitions for expense tracking, UPI, SMS capture, and Kharch Log terms.
- [Pricing](https://kharchlog.in/pricing/): INR 149 one-time lifetime unlock for Kharch Log on Android.

## Features

- [Manual Voice Entry](https://kharchlog.in/features/manual-voice-entry/): Add expenses by typing or voice when SMS is missing.
- [Sms Auto Capture](https://kharchlog.in/features/sms-auto-capture/): Read bank/UPI debit SMS and draft expenses automatically.
- [Review Inbox](https://kharchlog.in/features/review-inbox/): Confirm or edit SMS drafts before they hit your sheet.
- [Google Sheets Sync](https://kharchlog.in/features/google-sheets-sync/): Store every expense in your own Google Sheet (file-scoped).
- [Reports Insights](https://kharchlog.in/features/reports-insights/): Month/week/year spend, categories, and carry-forward balance.
- [Share Invoice](https://kharchlog.in/features/share-invoice/): Share a Pay-to image/PDF/text summary of spending.
